verdict.rationale: Skyvern's own docs describe official Python and TypeScript SDKs. They state that the Skyvern SDK connects to a cloud Chromium instance over CDP with Playwright layered on top, and they document concrete SDK methods such as page.extract and page.agent.run_task. missing for 10: SDK package/install and full reference documentation for both languages, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Integrate browser automation into your product with Python, TypeScript, or REST.
The Skyvern SDK connects to a cloud Chromium instance over CDP, layers Playwright on top, and injects AI into every page interaction.
Drive a cloud browser from Python or TypeScript with AI actions and Playwright, or run tasks and agents through the REST API.
you can extract structured data from any page using `page.extract` with a JSON schema, or by passing a `data_extraction_schema` to `page.agent.run_task`
